_why: The second reader is from a family the picked writer does not use, so the two readers disagree for real. Kimi K3 held the hostile student's voice best in the trials, but on the full 54-page script it gave no complete reply in 600 seconds, twice; the showrunner dropped it. Gemini 3.1 Pro is a stranger to Writer B (GPT-5.6 Luna Pro); if Writer A is picked, the two share a family and this should change.
